arxiv-2105-07409.title: Research of the hereditary dynamic Riccati system with modification fractional differential operator of Gerasimov-Caputo
arxiv-2105-07409.creator: Tverdyi D.A, Parovik R.I
arxiv-2105-07409.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the Cauchy problem for the Riccati differential equation with constant coefficients and a modified Gerasimov-Caputo type fractional differential operator of variable order. Using Newton’s numerical algorithm, calculation curves are constructed taking into account different values of the Cauchy problem parameters. The calculation results are compared with the previously obtained results.

arxiv-2201-12071.title: What is legitimate decision support?
arxiv-2201-12071.creator: Yves Meinard, Alexis Tsoukiàs
arxiv-2201-12071.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yves Meinard, Alexis Tsoukiàs. Decision support is the science and associated practice that consist in providing recommendations to decision makers facing problems, based on available theoretical knowledge and empirical data. Although this activity is often seen as being mainly concerned with solving mathematical problems and conceiving algorithms, it is essentially an empirical and socially framed activity, where interactions between clients and analysts, and between them and concerned third parties, play a crucial role.

arxiv-2301-02358.title: Berry curvature induced valley Hall effect in non-encapsulated hBN/Bilayer graphene heterostructure aligned with near-zero twist angle
arxiv-2301-02358.creator: Teppei Shintaku ∗, Afsal Kareekunnan ∗ , †, Masashi Akabori, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Hiroshi Mizuta
arxiv-2301-02358.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Teppei Shintaku ∗, Afsal Kareekunnan ∗ , †, Masashi Akabori, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Hiroshi Mizuta. Valley Hall effect has been observed in asymmetric single-layer and bilayer graphene systems. In single-layer graphene systems, asymmetry is introduced by aligning graphene with hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) with a near-zero twist angle, breaking the sub-lattice symmetry.

arxiv-2307-09267.title: Distilling Coarse-to-Fine Semantic Matching Knowledge for Weakly Supervised 3D Visual Grounding Thanks: Corresponding author
arxiv-2307-09267.creator: Zehan Wang Haifeng Huang Yang Zhao Linjun Li Xize Cheng
arxiv-2307-09267.description: Abstract 3D visual grounding involves finding a target object in a 3D scene that corresponds to a given sentence query. Although many approaches have been proposed and achieved impressive performance, they all require dense object-sentence pair annotations in 3D point clouds, which are both time-consuming and expensive.

arxiv-2406-09337.creator: Dolev Bashi, Tsevi Mazeh, Simchon Faigler
arxiv-2406-09337.description: Abstract We used the database of 1040 1040 short-period ( 1 ≤ P < 200 1\leq P<200 days) exoplanets radial-velocity (RV) orbits to study the planetary eccentricity-period (PEP) distribution. We first divided the sample into low- and high-mass exoplanet sub-samples based on the distribution of the (minimum) planetary masses, which displays a clear two-Gaussian distribution, separated at 0.

arxiv-2509-22471.title: Tunable optical lattices for the creation of matter-wave lattice solitons
arxiv-2509-22471.creator: Robbie Cruickshank, Arthur La Rooij, Ethan Kerr, Timon Hilker, Stefan Kuhr, Elmar Haller
arxiv-2509-22471.description: Abstract We present experimental techniques that employ an optical accordion lattice with dynamically tunable spacing to create and study bright matter-wave solitons in optical lattices. The system allows precise control of lattice parameters over a wide range of lattice spacings and depths.

arxiv-2512-07940.title: Detecting Neutrino Emission from Supernova Remnants: A Theoretically Motivated Target Catalog
arxiv-2512-07940.creator: Emily Simon, Rebecca Diesing, Damiano Caprioli, Stephen Sclafani
arxiv-2512-07940.description: Abstract Galactic supernova remnants (SNRs) are thought to accelerate cosmic rays (CRs) to several PeV energies, but this has yet to be confirmed as general behavior. Although several sources show ∼ 100 \sim 100 TeV γ − \gamma- rays, their hadronic origin is uncertain; a matching neutrino signal would provide definitive evidence.

arxiv-2601-18103.title: Scattering lengths of the J / ψ ​ π J/\psi\pi and J / ψ ​ K J/\psi K systems Journal: Physics Letters B
arxiv-2601-18103.creator: Jiang Yan, Xiong-Hui Cao, Meng-Lin Du, Feng-Kun Guo
arxiv-2601-18103.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Jiang Yan, Xiong-Hui Cao, Meng-Lin Du, Feng-Kun Guo. We investigate the low-energy interactions between the charmonium state J / ψ J/\psi and the light pseudoscalar mesons ( π \pi and K K ) within the framework of dispersion relations. We demonstrate that the symmetry-breaking terms in the chiral Lagrangian induce mixing between the bare charmonium fields, necessitating a diagonalization procedure to correctly identify the physical J / ψ J/\psi and ψ ′ \psi^{\prime} states.

plos-pone-0005645.creator: Balazs Gyorffy, Bela Molnar, Hermann Lage et al.
plos-pone-0005645.description: PLOS ONE research article. Several preprocessing algorithms for Affymetrix gene expression microarrays have been developed, and their performance on spike-in data sets has been evaluated previously. pmc-10545750.title: Climate-related experiences and harms in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic: results from a survey of 152,088 Mexican youth
pmc-10545750.creator: Ricardo Regules, Jessie Pinchoff, Ana C. Gomez-Ugarte, Tara F. Abularrage, Isabel Vieitez, Thoai D. Ngo
pmc-10545750.description: The dual crises of COVID-19 and climate change are impacting the lives of adolescents and young people as they transition to adulthood in an uncertain world, yet they are often excluded from research and political discourse. We surveyed young people about their needs and experiences, critical to engaging them and designing effective programs and policies to address these intersecting harms.

pmc-11477061.title: SARS-CoV-2 Vaccine Improved Hemostasis of a Patient with Protein S Deficiency: A Case Report
pmc-11477061.creator: Mohammad A Mohammad, Alaa Malik, Lekha Thangada, Diana Polanía-Villanueva, Jovanny Zabaleta, Rinku Majumder, Giovanni Luca Tiscia
pmc-11477061.description: A 16-year-old patient, while an infant, incurred right-sided hemiparesis and had difficulty breast feeding. She was later diagnosed with a neonatal stroke and her genetic testing showed a missense mutation in her PROS1 (Protein S) gene. Both her grandfather and father, but not her mother, had hereditary Protein S (PS) deficiency.

pmc-11533637.title: Rapid and selective quantitative colourimetric analysis of nitrite in water using a S-Nitrosothiol based method
pmc-11533637.creator: E. Latvyte, A. Greenwood, A. Bogush, J.E. Graves
pmc-11533637.description: Highlights•A novel colorimetric method for nitrite detection was developed.•Nitrite detected by formation of a pink S-nitrosothiol compound.•Broad detection range from 0.05 to 80 mmol l-1.•Adaptation of the assay into a pellet form for convenient field application.•Excellent selectivity with no interference from common ions, including nitrate. Introduction Nitrite (NO2-) detection is important in wastewater, drinking water, and natural surface waters.

pmc-11592690.title: Preliminary Study on Lutetium-177 and Gold Nanoparticles: Apoptosis and Radiation Enhancement in Hepatic Cancer Cell Line
pmc-11592690.creator: Maria Anthi Kouri, Anastasios Georgopoulos, George E. Manios, Eirini Maratou, Aris Spathis, Sofia Chatziioannou, Kalliopi Platoni, Efstathios P. Efstathopoulos
pmc-11592690.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study investigates a novel approach toward enhancing the efficacy of Lutetium-177 (Lu-177) radiopharmaceutical therapy by combining it with gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) in the HepG2 hepatic cancer cell line. Lu-177, known for its effective β radiation, also emits gamma rays at energies (113 keV and 208 keV) near the photoelectric absorption range, suggesting potential for targeted and localized radiation enhancement when used in conjunction with AuNPs.

pmc-11648326.title: Relativity, Rank, and the US News Health’s Cardiology, Heart, and Vascular Surgery Best Hospitals
pmc-11648326.creator: Alexandra Kats, Gordon H Morewood, George Moser, Eric Wilkens, Huaqing Zhao, Abul Kashem, Yoshiya Toyoda, Suyog Mokashi
pmc-11648326.description: ObjectiveVirtually anything can be ranked; the US News and World Report (USNWR or US News) ranks the top 50 hospitals specializing in cardiology, heart, and vascular surgery. Here the authors propose validating the effectiveness of rankings by comparing differences among the USNWR metrics across the top 50 hospitals.

pmc-11713556.title: Association of retirement with MRI markers of vascular injury and neurodegeneration in a diverse cohort: Findings from KHANDLE and STAR
pmc-11713556.creator: Nancy X Chen, Yi Lor, Charles S DeCarli, Lisa L Barnes, Paola Gilsanz, Kristen M George, Pauline Maillard, Elizabeth Rose Mayeda, M Maria Glymour, Rachel A Whitmer
pmc-11713556.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundPrior research suggests that early retirement is associated with cognitive decline, but mechanisms are unknown. We investigated whether retirement is associated with MRI biomarkers of neurodegeneration and vascular injury in two diverse cohorts of adults ages 65+.MethodsThe Kaiser Healthy Aging and Diverse Life Experiences and the Study of Healthy Aging in African Americans are harmonized longitudinal cohorts of racially/ethnically diverse adults who are long‐term Kaiser Permanente Northern California members.

pmc-11727511.title: Silencing LY6K Suppresses CD44+ EpCAM+ HCT116 Human Colon Cancer Stem Cells Growth: Insights from In Vitro and In Vivo Evidence
pmc-11727511.creator: Changhao Fu, Kuiqiao Chen, Jinyue Duan, Kun Liu, Miaomiao Li, Yuanyuan Chen, Zhongyi Cong, Yi Wang, Liudmila V Spirina
pmc-11727511.description: Lymphocyte antigen 6 complex, locus K (LY6K) is a putative oncogene in various human cancers, including colorectal cancer, where elevated expression is associated with poor prognosis. This study investigates the antitumor effects of LY6K in colon cancer stem cells (CCSCs) both in vitro and in vivo.

pmc-12535108.title: Clinical utility of a small diameter four-row stapler reload for large vessel transection in lung transplants
pmc-12535108.creator: Pablo G Sanchez, Christopher W Seder, Michael J Liptay, Neetha P Desai, Ernest Chan, Sylvain Anselme, Sandeep J Khandhar
pmc-12535108.description: BackgroundIn lung transplantation, there are multiple factors that can contribute to the need for a left atrial cuff reconstruction. While donor and recipient anatomy are inherent considerations during the procedure, other factors like type of surgical devices used may be controlled.

pmc-12641906.title: Relative Age Effect in Olympic Karate: Evidence from Tokyo 2020
pmc-12641906.creator: Sofia Serafini, Simone Ciaccioni, Gabriele Mascherini, Pascal Izzicupo
pmc-12641906.description: Background: The Relative Age Effect (RAE) refers to the advantage conferred to athletes born earlier within a selection year. In karate, particularly at the highest level, evidence is lacking. This study aimed to examine the presence of RAE among male and female karate athletes competing at the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games, in two competitive disciplines: kata and kumite.

pmc-12652076.title: Genetic Mapping and Transcriptomic Analysis of Sepal-Derived Seed Shape in Spinach
pmc-12652076.creator: Mahpara Fatima, Xiaokai Ma, Ehsan Khalid, Ray Ming, Kwon-Kyoo Kang
pmc-12652076.description: Spinach is a beloved vegetable crop and widely cultivated worldwide. It is dioecious with male and female plants, although monoecious mutations exist. Female spinach exhibits two distinct sepal morphologies—thorn-shaped and round-shaped determine seed shape and strongly influence seed handling, mechanized sowing, and cultivar classification.

uslaw-usc-t54-s101336.title: 54 U.S.C. § 101336 — Contracts for the management of field employee quarters
uslaw-usc-t54-s101336.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t54-s101336.description: United States Code, Title 54 (National Park Service And Related Programs); Chapter 1013 (Employees); Subchapter III (Housing Improvement). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Subject to the appropriation of necessary funds in advance, the Secretary may enter into contracts of any duration for the management, repair, and maintenance of field employee quarters. The contract shall contain terms and conditions that the Secretary considers.
